about: Which range a value is in, at and around every limit (#181, the owner: a value at a limit belongs to the range beyond it, ≥ for the highs, ≤ for the lows; very good up to and including its own limit). Bands.of decides it for every surface: the value's and the line's colour (extremely high from its own limit), the range word, the root status bar, the Mac menu bar, the notification's style, the widget tap, time in range, the report and the ring order. Run by GraphFixtureTest.bands (Android) and BandsFixtureTests (Mac). Format: ../README.md, 'Ranges at their limits'.
